name: bkg-core
description: BKG core: goal builder, goal orchestrator, plan engine and team as one merged OpenCode plugin set.

scripts.build: bun run build:packages && bun run build:plugins
scripts.build:packages: echo 'Building packages...' && for pkg in packages/*; do if [ -f "$pkg/package.json" ]; then echo "Building $pkg..."; (cd "$pkg" && bun run build); fi; done
scripts.build:plugins: echo 'Building plugins...' && for plug in plugins/*; do if [ -f "$plug/package.json" ]; then echo "Building $plug..."; (cd "$plug" && bun run build); fi; done
scripts.build:watch: echo 'watch mode is per-package: (cd packages/<pkg> && bun run dev)'
scripts.publish: echo 'Publish via release-please on merge to main'
